name: brand-ui
description: AI skills + subagents for the brand-ui design system: build, theme, and audit UI with the @qlik-coe-emea/qlabs-components-* component packages. Front door: brand-ui-start routes to build-new (brand-ui-new-app), improve-existing (brand-ui-migrate), or use-it (brand-ui). Backed by the brand-ui CLI (component manifest, project context, search, docs, design audit), the persistent brand-ui MCP (always-on API ground truth — search/docs/tokens/audit), and the Storybook MCP for real-component previews.
